verdict.root_cause: Four minutes before onset, platform-automation set checkout's CURRENCY_ADDR from unset to an explicit target (currencyservice:7001) [tr_e543acc6035c]. From then, checkout's outbound CurrencyService/Convert calls fail inside the gRPC client at name resolution with an empty address set, in under a millisecond and with no currency-side server span, propagating up as PlaceOrder failures through frontend and frontend-proxy [tr_95fcde2a0c8a]. The configured value itself is what breaks the call, matching checkout's abrupt break from an exactly-zero baseline at ~05:22:31 [tr_ffa3d3b945a9]. fraud-detection's later, smaller error rise and its intervals of no traffic at all [tr_c6768487cfdd] follow from orders no longer completing; its own logs show only healthy consumption and no dependency errors [tr_e38467c81193]. Currency has no recorded change of any kind [tr_fbdd6981359e].
verdict.reasoning: Timing, mechanism and locus converge. Checkout's error ratio is flat zero for 87 baseline samples then steps up ~2 minutes after the only recorded change to checkout [tr_ffa3d3b945a9, tr_e543acc6035c] - a step, not a ramp, which argues against saturation. The traces place the first error in checkout's own resolver, before any connection is attempted, which excludes a slow currency (no wait), malformed currency responses (no response exists) and upstream layers (their error status is inherited) [tr_95fcde2a0c8a]. The only change anywhere in the queried surface is the variable naming that very resolution target, moved from unset to set, while currency's change log is empty [tr_fbdd6981359e]. This is bad_config rather than dependency_latency or network_partition because the wrong value is the mechanism: nothing waits, nothing leaves the process, and checkout's cart/Redis and product-catalog/SQL dependencies resolve and respond normally in the same traces. The fix is reverting the variable, not rolling back an artifact - none changed.
open_questions: Span attributes were not exposed, so the failing Convert spans' actual target host:port was never read; the link to CURRENCY_ADDR is inferred from timing and mechanism [tr_95fcde2a0c8a].
Why the name fails to resolve - wrong name, wrong port, or currency having no registered endpoints - is untested; no dispatch examined currency's health, replicas or DNS state.

Checkout emitted zero log lines of any level over the window [tr_7fa5cca05599], and fraud-detection went silent at 05:20:25 [tr_e38467c81193]; neither silence is explained, and fraud-detection could hide a second fault.

alternatives.root_cause: Currency has no healthy endpoints behind its name, so any caller resolving it gets an empty address set.
alternatives.why_not: Explains the empty resolver result but not the timing: no change is recorded for currency across a 24-hour window [tr_fbdd6981359e], while the one recorded change rewires exactly this edge four minutes before onset [tr_e543acc6035c]. It also predicts other currency callers failing, which was never checked.

alternatives.root_cause: fraud-detection's consumer stopped while its socket stayed open, stalling the order pipeline.
alternatives.why_not: Its error change point at 05:24:31 is later than checkout's onset at 05:22:31 [tr_c6768487cfdd, tr_ffa3d3b945a9], and no checkout trace shows a fraud-detection hop failing - every failure is checkout's resolver [tr_95fcde2a0c8a], so this is downstream effect rather than cause.

proposal.expected_effect: Restoring checkout's prior environment removes the CURRENCY_ADDR value set four minutes before onset [tr_e543acc6035c]. Within minutes checkout's span-metrics error ratio should fall from its incident mean ~0.056 / peak ~0.42 back to the exact zero it held across 87 baseline samples [tr_ffa3d3b945a9], and in Tempo the outbound CurrencyService/Convert spans should stop failing sub-millisecond with a zero-address resolver error and instead show a currency-side server span [tr_95fcde2a0c8a]; PlaceOrder, frontend and frontend-proxy error status clears with it.
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if Convert spans still fail with an empty resolved-address set and checkout's error ratio stays above zero 7 minutes after the recreate — pointing instead at currency having no healthy endpoint or DNS record, which no dispatch tested. Two effects cannot be observed here: checkout emits zero log lines of any level [tr_7fa5cca05599], so no log confirmation exists, and fraud-detection's silence since 05:20:25 may persist from a separate fault.
proposal.risk: If the diagnosis is wrong this is a no-op that still costs a recreate: in-flight PlaceOrder calls dropped, in-process cache discarded, and recovery time spent while a currency-side fault goes unexamined. If checkout's unexplained total log silence reflects a process-level problem, the recreate may mask it.
proposal.blast_radius: checkout is recreated. frontend and frontend-proxy see connection resets during the recreate, on top of failures already occurring. currency sees Convert traffic return; cart, product-catalog, payment, shipping, email see a brief pause then resumption; fraud-detection sees order events resume if the revert works.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical alerts on checkout and fraud-detection two minutes apart with no open incidents to attribute them to; this cannot be dismissed. The shared flagd/downstream dependencies leave the cause genuinely open at this stage.
